# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

But… if you’re able to look it up and need me to confirm canceling it, I may actually want to keep it after all — I’ve been going back and forth on it because my brother keeps telling me I’ll regret canceling before summer.

Also, while you’re checking my account, I have another order with two t-shirts on it, and I can’t remember which ones I picked. Could you tell me which two t-shirts they are and what materials they’re made of?

My name is Sofia Hernandez, and I’m in Seattle, Washington, 98193. I don’t remember what email address I used, sorry.
